Reduce zone0 proportional gain to 3 %/°C and lengthen integral to 300 s to curb overshoot and meet 1.5 °C regulation band; keep zone1 at nominal gains.
Set zone0 proportional gain to minimum 0.5 %/°C and longest integral 600 s so controller output stays low, preventing full‑power overshoot and keeping predicted error within 1.5 °C; zone1 unchanged.

Raise zone0 proportional gain to 5.5 %/°C and set integral time to 200 s to provide enough heating power to reach the 50 °C setpoint while staying within allowed gain (≤20) and integral (20‑600 s) ranges, keeping predicted regulation error under 1.5 °C; zone1 gains unchanged.
